## Profile checklist (delete if this isn't a profile change)

- [ ] My files are in `content/authors/<username>/`, and `authors:` in `_index.md` matches `<username>`
- [ ] `user_groups` is exactly one of the groups listed in the template
- [ ] My photo is named `avatar.jpg` or `avatar.png`, is a real JPG/PNG (not a renamed HEIC/WebP), and is under 10 MB
- [ ] The automatic check on this pull request is green ✅
